scripts.title: Fly and NoClip universal
scripts.author: Xenure
scripts.summary: UNIVERSAL SCRIPT OPEN SOURCE No-clip + Fly
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local MAX_SPEED = 170
local DEFAULT_SPEED = 85
local SHOW_GREEN_BACKGROUND = false

local DRAG_STIFFNESS = 180
local DRAG_DAMPING = 22
local SLIDER_STIFFNESS = 260
local SLIDER_DAMPING = 28

local FONT = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Roboto.json", Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
local FONT_BOLD = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Roboto.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold)

local COLORS = {
	panel = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18),
	button = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26),
	buttonOn = Color3.fromRGB(74, 114, 232),
	drag = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22),
	accent = Color3.fromRGB(91, 134, 255),
	track = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 242, 242),
	dim = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
}
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

local PANEL_W, PANEL_H, PANEL_COLLAPSED_H = 312, 252, 56

local BEZEL_LIGHT_ALPHA = 0.7
local BEZEL_DARK_ALPHA = 0.5

local function new(className, props, parent)
	local obj = Instance.new(className)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
		obj[k] = v
	end
	if parent then
		obj.Parent = parent
	end
	return obj
end

local function addCorner(radius, parent)
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
end

local function isPointer(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function isMove(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function newSpring(initial, stiffness, damping)
	local spring = { value = initial, velocity = 0, target = initial }

	function spring.step(dt)
		dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 30)
		local force = (spring.target - spring.value) * stiffness - spring.velocity * damping
		spring.velocity += force * dt
		spring.value += spring.velocity * dt
	end

	function spring.isSettled()
		return math.abs(spring.target - spring.value) < 0.01 and math.abs(spring.velocity) < 0.01
	end

	return spring
end

local H_X = { 12, 6, 0, 18 }
local V_Y = { 0, -6, -12, -18 }

local function buildCarbon(surface, w, h, radius)
	local base = new("Frame", {
		Name = "CarbonBase",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.65,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 1,
	}, surface)
	addCorner(radius, base)

	local layer = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Carbon",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 2,
	}, surface)

	local vSeq = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.66),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.9),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.98),
	})

	for ty = 0, math.floor((h + 18) / 24) do
		for tx = -1, math.floor(w / 24) do
			local ox, oy = tx * 24, ty * 24
			for i = 0, 3 do
				new("Frame", {
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox + H_X[i + 1], oy + i * 6),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 5),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.95,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 1,
				}, layer)

				local v = new("Frame", {
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox + i * 6, oy + V_Y[i + 1] + 1),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 10),
					BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 2,
				}, layer)
				new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = vSeq }, v)
			end
		end
	end

	local sheen = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Sheen",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 4,
	}, surface)
	addCorner(radius, sheen)
	new("UIGradient", {
		Rotation = 45,
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.93),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.98),
		}),
	}, sheen)
end

local function addBezel(surface)
	local stroke = new("UIStroke", {
		Thickness = 1,
		Color = WHITE,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		ZIndex = 6,
	}, surface)

	local gradient = new("UIGradient", {
		Rotation = 90,
		Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, WHITE),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, BLACK),
		}),
		Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, BEZEL_LIGHT_ALPHA),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, BEZEL_DARK_ALPHA),
		}),
	}, stroke)

	return gradient
end

local function makeElement(parent, o)
	local el = { on = false }

	el.root = new("Frame", {
		Name = o.name,
		LayoutOrder = o.order or 0,
		Size = o.size,
		Position = o.position or UDim2.new(),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent)

	el.surface = new("Frame", {
		Name = "Surface",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = o.color,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		ZIndex = 2,
	}, el.root)
	addCorner(o.radius, el.surface)

	buildCarbon(el.surface, o.w, o.h, o.radius)
	el.bezel = addBezel(el.surface)

	function el.set(sunk, shift)
		el.bezel.Rotation = sunk and 270 or 90
		el.surface.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, shift and 1 or 0)
	end
	el.set(false, false)

	return el
end

local function addLabel(el, text, size, font, color)
	return new("TextLabel", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = text,
		TextSize = size,
		TextColor3 = color,
		FontFace = font,
		ZIndex = 8,
	}, el.surface)
end

local function addHit(el)
	el.hit = new("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		ZIndex = 20,
	}, el.root)
	return el.hit
end

local function wirePress(el)
	local hit = addHit(el)
	local function release()
		el.set(el.on, false)
	end
	hit.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		el.set(true, true)
	end)
	hit.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
	hit.MouseLeave:Connect(release)
	return hit
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "FlyPanel",
	ResetOnSpawn = false,
	IgnoreGuiInset = true,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

if SHOW_GREEN_BACKGROUND then
	new("Frame", {
		Name = "Backdrop",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, gui)
end

local panel = makeElement(gui, {
	name = "Panel",
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H),
	w = PANEL_W,
	h = PANEL_H,
	radius = 10,
	color = COLORS.panel,
})
panel.root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.root.Active = true

local content = new("Frame", {
	Name = "Content",
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	ZIndex = 3,
}, panel.root)
new("UIPadding", {
	PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10),
	PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
	PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
	PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
}, content)
new("UIListLayout", {
	FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
}, content)

local topRow = new("Frame", {
	Name = "TopRow",
	LayoutOrder = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, content)

local dragBar = makeElement(topRow, {
	name = "Drag",
	size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 28),
	w = 248,
	h = 28,
	radius = 6,
	color = COLORS.drag,
})
addLabel(dragBar, "Drag", 11, FONT, COLORS.dim)
local dragHit = addHit(dragBar)

local minimize = makeElement(topRow, {
	name = "Minimize",
	size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
	position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 0),
	w = 36,
	h = 36,
	radius = 6,
	color = COLORS.button,
})
local minLabel = addLabel(minimize, "-", 20, FONT_BOLD, COLORS.text)
local minHit = wirePress(minimize)

local function makeToggle(name, title, order)
	local ui = makeElement(content, {
		name = name,
		order = order,
		size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
		w = 292,
		h = 58,
		radius = 6,
		color = COLORS.button,
	})
	ui.title = title
	ui.label = addLabel(ui, title .. ": OFF", 28, FONT, COLORS.text)
	wirePress(ui)
	return ui
end

local function setToggle(ui, on)
	ui.on = on
	ui.label.Text = ui.title .. ": " .. (on and "ON" or "OFF")
	ui.surface.BackgroundColor3 = on and COLORS.buttonOn or COLORS.button
	ui.set(on, false)
end

local flyToggle = makeToggle("Fly", "Fly", 2)
local noclipToggle = makeToggle("NoClip", "No-Clip", 3)

local speedHolder = new("Frame", {
	Name = "Speed",
	LayoutOrder = 4,
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, content)
local speedShadow = new("TextLabel", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Speed: " .. DEFAULT_SPEED,
	TextSize = 24,
	TextColor3 = BLACK,
	TextTransparency = 0.65,
	FontFace = FONT,
	ZIndex = 1,
}, speedHolder)
local speedLabel = new("TextLabel", {
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2),
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Text = "Speed: " .. DEFAULT_SPEED,
	TextSize = 24,
	TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
	FontFace = FONT,
	ZIndex = 2,
}, speedHolder)

local track = makeElement(content, {
	name = "Track",
	order = 5,
	size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
	w = 292,
	h = 14,
	radius = 6,
	color = COLORS.track,
})
track.set(true, false)

local fill = makeElement(track.surface, {
	name = "Fill",
	size = UDim2.fromScale(DEFAULT_SPEED / MAX_SPEED, 1),
	w = 292,
	h = 14,
	radius = 6,
	color = COLORS.accent,
})
fill.root.ZIndex = 7

local trackHit = addHit(track)

local panelX = newSpring(0, DRAG_STIFFNESS, DRAG_DAMPING)
local panelY = newSpring(0, DRAG_STIFFNESS, DRAG_DAMPING)
local fillPct = newSpring(DEFAULT_SPEED / MAX_SPEED, SLIDER_STIFFNESS, SLIDER_DAMPING)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

dragHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointer(input) then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Vector2.new(panelX.target, panelY.target)
	end
end)

local collapsed = false
local collapsibles = { flyToggle.root, noclipToggle.root, speedHolder, track.root }

minHit.Activated:Connect(function()
	collapsed = not collapsed
	for _, obj in ipairs(collapsibles) do
		obj.Visible = not collapsed
	end
	panel.root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, collapsed and PANEL_COLLAPSED_H or PANEL_H)
	minLabel.Text = collapsed and "+" or "-"
end)

local speed = DEFAULT_SPEED
local sliding = false

local function setSpeedFromX(x)
	local pct = math.clamp((x - track.root.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.root.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
	fillPct.target = pct
	speed = math.round(pct * MAX_SPEED)
	speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. speed
	speedShadow.Text = speedLabel.Text
end

trackHit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointer(input) then
		sliding = true
		setSpeedFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and isMove(input) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		panelX.target = startPos.X + delta.X
		panelY.target = startPos.Y + delta.Y
	end
	if sliding and isMove(input) then
		setSpeedFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if isPointer(input) then
		dragging = false
		sliding = false
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	panelX.step(dt)
	panelY.step(dt)
	panel.root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, panelX.value, 0.5, panelY.value)

	fillPct.step(dt)
	fill.root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(fillPct.value, 0, 1), 1)
end)

local character, humanoid, root
local originalCollide = {}
local flyOn = false
local noclipOn = false

local function onCharacterAdded(char)
	character = char
	humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	originalCollide = {}
	if flyOn then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
if player.Character then
	onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end

local function setFly(on)
	flyOn = on
	setToggle(flyToggle, on)
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = on
	end
	if not on and root then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

flyToggle.hit.Activated:Connect(function()
	setFly(not flyOn)
end)

local function setNoclip(on)
	noclipOn = on
	setToggle(noclipToggle, on)

	if not on then
		for part, value in pairs(originalCollide) do
			if part.Parent then
				part.CanCollide = value
			end
		end
		originalCollide = {}
	end
end

noclipToggle.hit.Activated:Connect(function()
	setNoclip(not noclipOn)
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not character or not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	if noclipOn then
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if originalCollide[part] == nil then
					originalCollide[part] = part.CanCollide
				end
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	if flyOn then
		local cf = camera.CFrame
		local dir = Vector3.zero

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cf.LookVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cf.LookVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cf.RightVector end

    if mode == "Torso" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head") or getInstanceRoot(character)
    end
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or getInstanceRoot(character)
end
local function getCrosshair()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return nil end
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local x = mouseLocation.X
    local y = mouseLocation.Y
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local mouseLock = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("MouseLock")
    if mouseLock and mouseLock:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true and UserInputService.PreferredInput ~= Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
        local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
        x = viewportSize.X / 2
        y = viewportSize.Y / 2
    end
    return Vector2.new(x, y)
end
local function hasClearShot(origin, targetPart)
    if not origin or not targetPart then return false end
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.1 then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = getIgnoredParts()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    if not ok then return false end
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

-- Gun
local function getGunTarget(allowWalls)
    local murderer = findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if not murderer or not playerIsAlive(murderer, playerData) or not murderer.Character then return nil, nil, nil end
    local character = murderer.Character
    local preferred
    if State.GunAimTargetPart == "Torso" then
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Head"), }
    else
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), }
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position or (root and root.Position)
    local targetPart
    for _, part in ipairs(preferred) do
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if allowWalls or not origin or hasClearShot(origin, part) then
                targetPart = part
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not targetPart then return nil, murderer, nil end
    local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 120 end
    local distance = root and (targetPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local leadTime = math.clamp(0.035 + distance / 2200, 0.035, 0.09)
    local predicted = targetPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(predicted), murderer, targetPart
end
local KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
local KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0

-- Knife
local function getKnifeTarget(requireVisible)
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local aimPoint = getCrosshair()
    if not root or not camera or not aimPoint then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local viewOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local now = os.clock()
    local fov = math.max(40, tonumber(State.KnifeAimFOV) or 220)
    local function evaluate(player, sticky)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not playerIsAlive(player, playerData) or not player.Character then return nil end
        local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        if role == "Murderer" then return nil end
        local part = getCharacterKnifeAimPart( player.Character, State.KnifeAimTargetPart )
        if not part then return nil end
        local screenPosition, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - aimPoint).Magnitude
        local allowedFov = sticky and (fov * 1.25) or fov
        if screenDistance > allowedFov then return nil end
        if requireVisible and not hasClearShot(viewOrigin, part) then return nil end
        local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        return part, screenDistance + distance * 0.025, distance
    end
    if KnifeAimStickyPlayer and now <= KnifeAimStickyUntil then
        local part, _, distance = evaluate(KnifeAimStickyPlayer, true)
        if part then
            local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
            local leadTime = math.clamp(distance / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
            return CFrame.new(part.Position + velocity * leadTime), KnifeAimStickyPlayer, part
        end
    end
    local bestTarget
    local bestPart
    local bestDistance
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local part, score, distance = evaluate(player, false)
        if part and score < bestScore then
            bestTarget = player
            bestPart = part
            bestDistance = distance
            bestScore = score
        end
    end
    if not bestTarget or not bestPart then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    KnifeAimStickyPlayer = bestTarget
    KnifeAimStickyUntil = now + 0.28
    local velocity = bestPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
    local leadTime = math.clamp((bestDistance or 0) / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
    local targetPosition = bestPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(targetPosition), bestTarget, bestPart
end
function getIgnoredParts()
    local ignored = {}
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        table.insert(ignored, character)
    end
    for _, instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
        table.insert(ignored, instance)
    end
    return ignored
end
local function raycastForGunAimV2(origin, direction, params)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if type(OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction) == "function" then
            return OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction( workspace, origin, direction, params )
        end
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    return ok and result or nil
end
local function isWeaponRay(origin, direction)
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return false end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude < 297 or magnitude > 303 then return false end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end
    if (origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 3.5 then return false end
    if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then
        local ok, caller = pcall(getcallingscript)
        if ok and typeof(caller) == "Instance" then
            local path = string.lower(caller:GetFullName())
            if string.find(path, "camera", 1, true) or string.find(path, "zoom", 1, true) or string.find(path, "occlusion", 1, true) then
                return false
            end
            if string.find(path, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(path, "weapon", 1, true) or string.find(path, "shoot", 1, true)
                or string.find(path, "knife", 1, true) or string.find(path, "projectile", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function raycastToTarget(targetPart)
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then return nil end
    local targetCharacter = targetPart.Parent
    local targetPosition = targetPart.Position
    local ignored = getIgnoredParts()
    for _, child in ipairs(targetCharacter:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(ignored, child)
        end
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local right = targetPart.CFrame.RightVector
    local forward = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
    local offsets = { -forward * 5, forward * 5, right * 5, -right * 5, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), }
    for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
        local origin = targetPosition + offset
        local direction = targetPosition - origin
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local ok, result = pcall(raycastForGunAimV2, origin, direction, params )
            if ok and result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter) then return result end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function getGunRayHit(params)
    local _, murderer, targetPart = getGunTarget(false)

-- Shot redirection
local function isGunShotRemote(instance)
    if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not (instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then return false end
    local lowerName = string.lower(instance.Name)
    local lowerPath = string.lower(instance:GetFullName())
    if not (string.find(lowerName, "shoot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "shot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "fire", 1, true)
        or string.find(lowerName, "hit", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "shootgun", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "knifeserver", 1, true)) then
        return false
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local ancestor = instance.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= game do
        if ancestor:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(ancestor.Name)
            local isGun = ancestor:FindFirstChild("IsGun") ~= nil or CollectionService:HasTag(ancestor, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun"
            return isGun and ancestor.Parent == character
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return getEquippedGunTool() ~= nil
end
local function getGunRemoteTarget()

        local targetCFrame, _, targetPart = getGunTarget(State.GunRageMode == true)
        if targetCFrame and targetPart then return targetCFrame.Position, targetPart end
        return nil, nil
    end
    if premiumGunAimIsEnabled() then
        local targetCFrame, _, targetPart = getPremiumGunAimCFrame()
        if targetCFrame and targetPart then return targetPart.Position, targetPart end

    end
    return nil, nil
end
local function rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
    local targetPosition, targetPart = getGunRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if State.GunRageMode then
            local spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
            if spoofedOrigin and targetCFrame then
                args[1] = spoofedOrigin
                args[2] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        else
            args[2] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        end
    end
    local function replaceArgument(index)
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[index] = targetPosition
            return true
        elseif valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[index] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Ray" then
            local originalRay = args[index]
            local direction = targetPosition - originalRay.Origin
            if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                args[index] = Ray.new(originalRay.Origin, direction.Unit * math.max(originalRay.Direction.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude) )
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Instance" and args[index] ~= LocalPlayer.Character and targetPart then
            args[index] = targetPart
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and replaceArgument(2) then return true end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        if index ~= 2 and replaceArgument(index) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function isKnifeThrowRemote(instance)

        or string.find(lowerPath, "projectile", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(lowerPath, "knife", 1, true) ~= nil

    local playerData = getRoundData()

local function rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
    local targetPosition, targetPart = getKnifeRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    local wallBang = State.KnifeRageMode == true
    local spoofedOrigin
    local targetCFrame
    if wallBang then
        spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
    else
        targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local normalOrigin = root and root.Position or targetPosition
    local throwOrigin = wallBang and spoofedOrigin and spoofedOrigin.Position or normalOrigin
    local throwDirection = targetPosition - throwOrigin
    if throwDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        throwDirection = throwDirection.Unit
    else
        throwDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end
    if argumentCount == 1 then
        local valueType = typeof(args[1])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[1] = targetCFrame
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[1] = args[1].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
            return true
        end
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin
        end
        args[2] = targetCFrame
        return true
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin.Position
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin
            else
                args[index] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Vector3" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin.Position
            else
                args[index] = args[index].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function sendWeaponRemote(remote, method, args, argumentCount)
    if method == "FireServer" then
        remote.FireServer(remote, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
        return nil
    end
    return remote.InvokeServer(remote, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
end
local function callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    if method == "Raycast" or method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
        local ok, directMethod = pcall(function()
            return self[method]
        end)
        if ok and type(directMethod) == "function" then return directMethod(self, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount)) end
    end
    return OriginalWorkspaceNamecall(self, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
end

-- Weapon hooks
local function installNamecallHook()
    if OriginalWorkspaceNamecall or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end
    local namecallHook
    namecallHook = function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args = { ... }
        local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isKnifeThrowRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.GunAimV2 or State.GunRageMode or premiumGunAimIsEnabled())
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isGunShotRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if self == workspace and method == "Raycast" and not BypassWeaponAimRedirect and not State.RoundCombatSuspended and isPlaying() then
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") and not State.GunRageMode and (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]) then
                local result = getGunRayHit(args[3])
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
                and ((State.KnifeRageMode and isKnifeWallBangRay(args[1], args[2])) or (not State.KnifeRageMode and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]))) then
                local result = getKnifeRayHit()
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
        return callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    end
    OriginalWorkspaceNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", type(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(namecallHook) or namecallHook )
end

local function installWeaponHook()
    if type(WeaponService) ~= "table" or WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked then return end
    WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = true
    local function redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if State.RoundCombatSuspended then return nil end
        if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return nil end
        if (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and not State.GunRageMode and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") then
            local targetCFrame = getGunTargetCFrame()
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        if (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2)) and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then
            local targetCFrame = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local mouseWrapper
    local targetWrapper
    mouseWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceMouseRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    targetWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceTargetRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
        mouseWrapper = newcclosure(mouseWrapper)
        targetWrapper = newcclosure(targetWrapper)
    end
    local hooked = false
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame) == "function"
        and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition) == "function" then
        local okMouse, rawMouse = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame, mouseWrapper )
        local okTarget, rawTarget = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition, targetWrapper )
        if okMouse and okTarget and type(rawMouse) == "function" and type(rawTarget) == "function" then
            WeaponServiceMouseRaw = rawMouse
            WeaponServiceTargetRaw = rawTarget
            hooked = true
        end
    end
    if not hooked then
        WeaponServiceMouseRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        WeaponServiceTargetRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = mouseWrapper
        WeaponService.GetTargetPosition = targetWrapper
    end
end

			windowDragging = true
			windowDragStart = input.Position
			windowStartPos = mainFrame.Position
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and windowDragging then
			local delta = input.Position - windowDragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(windowStartPos.X.Scale, windowStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, windowStartPos.Y.Scale, windowStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
			local targetRotation = math.clamp(delta.X * 0.1, -6, 6)
			mainFrame.Rotation = mainFrame.Rotation + (targetRotation - mainFrame.Rotation) * 0.2
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			windowDragging = false
		end
	end)

	local draggingVol = false
	volSliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	local function updateTexts()

		noclipBtn.Text = states.NoClip and getTxt("noclipOn") or getTxt("noclipOff")

		pauseMusicBtn.Text = getTxt("pause")

	local function switchPage(fromContainer, toContainer)
		playClickSound()
		toContainer.Visible = true
		toContainer.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
		
		TweenService:Create(fromContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(-1, 0, 0, 30)}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(toContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)}):Play()
		
		task.wait(0.3)
		fromContainer.Visible = false
	end

	toolsMenuBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchPage(mainMenuContainer, toolsMenuContainer) end)
	playerListPageBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchPage(mainMenuContainer, playerListPageContainer) end)
	langSelectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchPage(mainMenuContainer, langMenuContainer) end)

	backToMainBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchPage(toolsMenuContainer, mainMenuContainer) end)
	backFromListBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchPage(playerListPageContainer, mainMenuContainer) end)
	backLangBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchPage(langMenuContainer, mainMenuContainer) end)

		currentLanguage = "PL"
		updateTexts()
		showSuccessNotification("Zmieniono język na PL")

	end)

	enBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		currentLanguage = "EN"
		updateTexts()
		showSuccessNotification("Language changed to EN")
		switchPage(langMenuContainer, mainMenuContainer)
	end)

		playClickSound()

		TweenService:Create(mainFrame, tweenInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.3)
		mainFrame.Visible = false
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 310)
		mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15

		toggleCircle.Visible = true
		TweenService:Create(toggleCircle, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 46), Rotation = 360}):Play()
	end

	local function animateOpen()
		playClickSound()
		toggleCircle.Visible = false
		toggleCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 46)
		toggleCircle.Rotation = 0
		
		mainFrame.Visible = true
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		mainFrame.Rotation = -15
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		TweenService:Create(mainFrame, tweenInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 310), Rotation = 0}):Play()

	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(animateClose)
	toggleCircle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(animateOpen)

	speedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()

		speedBtn.Text = speedEnabled and getTxt("speedOn") or getTxt("speedOff")
		speedBtn.BackgroundColor3 = speedEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 220)
		showSuccessNotification(speedEnabled and "Speed ON" or "Speed OFF")
	end)

	infJumpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()
		states.InfJump = not states.InfJump
		infJumpBtn.Text = states.InfJump and getTxt("jumpOn") or getTxt("jumpOff")
		infJumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = states.InfJump and Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 220)
		showSuccessNotification(states.InfJump and "InfJump ON" or "InfJump OFF")
	end)

	UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		if states.InfJump and player.Character then
			local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
		end
	end)

	noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()
		states.NoClip = not states.NoClip
		noclipBtn.Text = states.NoClip and getTxt("noclipOn") or getTxt("noclipOff")
		noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = states.NoClip and Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 220)
		showSuccessNotification(states.NoClip and "NoClip ON" or "NoClip OFF")
	end)

	espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()
		states.ESP = not states.ESP
		espBtn.Text = states.ESP and getTxt("espOn") or getTxt("espOff")
		espBtn.BackgroundColor3 = states.ESP and Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 220)
		showSuccessNotification(states.ESP and "ESP ON" or "ESP OFF")
		if not states.ESP then

				if p.Character then

					if hl then hl:Destroy() end

	end)

	savePosBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	tpPosBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	playMusicBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

			showSuccessNotification("Błędne ID Muzyki!")
			return
		end
		if not customSoundInstance then
			customSoundInstance = Instance.new("Sound")
			customSoundInstance.Looped = true
			customSoundInstance.Parent = SoundService
		end
		customSoundInstance.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. soundId

		showSuccessNotification("Odtwarzanie muzyki!")
	end)

				customSoundInstance:Resume()
				showSuccessNotification("Wznowiono muzykę")
			end
		end
	end)

	stopMusicBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()
		if customSoundInstance then
			customSoundInstance:Stop()
			showSuccessNotification("Zatrzymano muzykę")
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if player.Character then
			local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				if speedEnabled then hum.WalkSpeed = boostSpeed else hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
			end
			if states.NoClip then
				for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
				end
			end
		end
		
		if states.ESP then
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if p ~= player and p.Character then
					local char = p.Character
					if not char:FindFirstChild("KM_ESP") then
						local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
						hl.Name = "KM_ESP"
						hl.Adornee = char
						hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
						hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
						hl.Parent = char
					end
				end
			end
		end
		
		local isPlaying = customSoundInstance and customSoundInstance.IsPlaying
		for i, barData in ipairs(audioBars) do
			local width = 28
			local height = 6
			if isPlaying then
				width = math.clamp(math.floor(22 + (customMusicVolume * 10)), 15, 32)
				local wave = math.sin((tick() * barData.speed) + barData.offset)
				local scaleMultiplier = 50 + (customMusicVolume * 220)
				height = math.clamp(math.floor(math.abs(wave) * scaleMultiplier), 8, 290)
			end
			barData.frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		end
	end)

	local function giveBombAndPump(targetPlayer)
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character
		local targetRoot = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not myRoot or not targetRoot then return end

		local savedCFrameRef = myRoot.CFrame
		myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5)
		task.wait(0.08)

		pcall(function()
			local bombTool = myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") or player.Backpack:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if bombTool then bombTool.Parent = targetPlayer.Backpack end
		end)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, i * 2, 0)
			task.wait(0.04)
		end

		task.wait(0.08)
		if myRoot and myRoot.Parent then myRoot.CFrame = savedCFrameRef end
	end

	local function populatePlayerList()
		for _, child in ipairs(playerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
		end

		local count = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= player then
				count = count + 1
				local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
				pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 26)
				pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 38)
				pBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
				pBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
				pBtn.TextSize = 11
				pBtn.Text = "  " .. p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")"
				pBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				pBtn.ZIndex = 2
				pBtn.Parent = playerListFrame

				local pCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
				pCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
				pCorner.Parent = pBtn

				local pStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
				pStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
				pStroke.Thickness = 1.2
				pStroke.Parent = pBtn

				pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					playClickSound()
					local origText = pBtn.Text
					pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 80)
					pBtn.Text = "  Dano & Pompujesz: " .. p.Name .. "!"
					showSuccessNotification("Bombę dano graczowi " .. p.Name)
					giveBombAndPump(p)
					task.delay(0.9, function()
						if pBtn and pBtn.Parent then
							pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 38)
							pBtn.Text = origText
						end
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		playerListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 30)
	end

	refreshBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()
		populatePlayerList()
		showSuccessNotification("Odświeżono listę!")
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(populatePlayerList)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(populatePlayerList)
	populatePlayerList()
end

scripts.code:
--[[
KURKIN LIFE | V10 STABILITY GUARD
Based on V10 Auto Spawn / Kuki G2 / rise=15 / fall=15 / yaw=3775.
Preserves original spin and recovery. Adds bounded planar physical assist
(X/Z only), separate seat-to-rider relative-drift monitoring, spin failure
watchdog, and idle warning. Does not anchor the G2 or use continuous PivotTo.
Client-side physics is NOT a guarantee against server corrections, network
ownership changes, lost seats, AFK disconnection, or resets.
STATIC REVIEW ONLY. Requires observation in the game before leaving unattended.
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Stop earlier standalone protection scripts.
local environment = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
if environment then
    for _, key in ipairs({"ScooterAntiBreakV1", "ScooterAntiBreakV2", "ScooterAFKLock"}) do
        local previous = environment[key]
        if previous and type(previous.Destroy) == "function" then
            pcall(function() previous.Destroy() end)
            environment[key] = nil
        end
    end
end

for _, name in ipairs({"SpinMenu", "ScooterCheck"}) do
    local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild(name)
    if old then old:Destroy() end
end

-- הגדרות
local targetDegrees = 5300
local waitTime = 0.050
local liftHeight = 2
-- TURBO: extremely fast vertical travel; rotation is raised only slightly.
local riseSpeed = 15        -- studs/sec (original rise cap: 6)
local descentSpeed = 15     -- studs/sec (original descent: 8)
local maxSpeed = 3775        -- degrees/sec (requested spin speed)
local finishResponse = 24
local autoSpawn = true
local autoEquip = true
local homeCFrame
local recoveryTravelled = false
local recoveryReturned = false
local travelAttempts = 0
local returnAttempts = 0

local enabled = false
local phase = "off"
local elapsed = 0
local stableTime = 0
local targetHeight = 0
local baseHeight = 0         -- height before each rise; precise stop for fast descent
local turned = 0
local previousAngle = 0
local fixedX = 0
local fixedZ = 0
local descentObserved = false

local root
local humanoid
local oldAutoRotate

local connections = {}
local effectTweens = {}
local alive = true
local random = Random.new()

-- Rider retention functions (defined below; called from OFF/cleanup).
local maintainRiderLock
local releaseRiderLock
local releaseStability
local maintainStability
local stabilityHealth

-- יצירת התפריט
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SpinMenu"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 20
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function corner(object, radius)
    local item = Instance.new("UICorner")
    item.CornerRadius = radius
    item.Parent = object
end

local function label(parent, text, size, position, dimensions)
    local item = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    item.Text = text
    item.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    item.TextSize = size
    item.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    item.Position = position
    item.Size = dimensions
    item.ZIndex = 3
    item.Parent = parent
    return item
end

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "AutoButton"
button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 100)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0.5, -50)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
button.BorderSizePixel = 0
button.Text = ""
button.AutoButtonColor = false
button.ClipsDescendants = true
button.Active = true
button.Parent = gui
corner(button, UDim.new(0.5, 0))

local surface = Instance.new("UIGradient")
surface.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(50, 220, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, Color3.fromRGB(100, 125, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, Color3.fromRGB(175, 90, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 205))
})
surface.Rotation = 15
surface.Parent = button

-- תנועה רציפה במילוי עצמו
local surfaceTween = TweenService:Create(
    surface,
    TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
        Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1),
    {Rotation = 375}
)
surfaceTween:Play()

local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
border.Thickness = 3
border.Transparency = 0.05
border.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
border.Parent = button

local rainbow = Instance.new("UIGradient")
rainbow.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 190)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(145, 95, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(65, 225, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 170)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 190))
})
rainbow.Parent = border

local rainbowTween = TweenService:Create(
    rainbow,
    TweenInfo.new(
        7, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
        Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1
    ),
    {Rotation = 360}
)
rainbowTween:Play()

-- השתקפות עליונה
local reflection = Instance.new("Frame")
reflection.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 5)
reflection.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 35)
reflection.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

corner(reflection, UDim.new(0.5, 0))

local reflectionFade = Instance.new("UIGradient")

    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
})
reflectionFade.Parent = reflection

local lightLine = Instance.new("Frame")

lightLine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 2)
lightLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
lightLine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
lightLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
lightLine.ZIndex = 3
lightLine.Parent = button
corner(lightLine, UDim.new(1, 0))

local brand = label(
    button, "S P I N   S T U D I O", 10,
    UDim2.fromOffset(20, 10),
    UDim2.fromOffset(230, 16)
)
brand.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 65, 140)
brand.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.65

-- אותיות שמנמנות עם שכבת עומק והברקה

local function playEffect()
    for _, tween in ipairs(effectTweens) do
        tween:Cancel()
    end
    table.clear(effectTweens)

    local function animate(object, duration, properties)
        local tween = TweenService:Create(
            object,
            TweenInfo.new(
                duration,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            properties
        )
        table.insert(effectTweens, tween)
        tween:Play()
    end

    toastLabel.Text = text

        if not alive or version ~= toastVersion then return end

        toastTween = TweenService:Create(
            toast,
            TweenInfo.new(0.2),
            {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 45),

            toast.Visible = false
            toastRGBTween:Pause()
        end)
    end)

-- גרירה ללא אנימציות מיקום
local pointer
local dragging = false
local moved = false
local pointerStart
local buttonStart

table.insert(connections, button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    local kind = input.UserInputType

    if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end
    if dragging then return end

    pointer = input
    dragging = true
    moved = false
    pointerStart = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    buttonStart = button.AbsolutePosition
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end

    local mouseMove =
        pointer.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

    if not mouseMove and input ~= pointer then return end

    local position = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    local delta = position - pointerStart

    if delta.Magnitude >= 7 then moved = true end
    if not moved then return end

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
    local size = button.AbsoluteSize + Vector2.new(0, 202 - 100)

    button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
        math.clamp(
            buttonStart.X + delta.X,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.X - size.X - 8)
        ),
        math.clamp(
            buttonStart.Y + delta.Y,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - size.Y - 8)
        )
    )
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == pointer then
        dragging = false
        pointer = nil
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
    dragging = false
    pointer = nil
    moved = true
end))

local function cancelRecovery()
    if recoveryPrompt then
        pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
    end
    recoveryPrompt = nil
    recoveryActive = false
    recoveryElapsed = 0
    recoveryStable = 0

    stagePhase = "none"

    stageAttempts = 0
    travelAttempts = 0
    returnAttempts = 0
end

local function releaseCharacter()
    if releaseStability then releaseStability() end
    cancelRecovery()
    if root and root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end

    if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
        humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
    end

    root = nil
    humanoid = nil
end

local function stop()
    enabled = false
    if releaseStability then releaseStability() end
    if releaseRiderLock then releaseRiderLock() end
    phase = "off"
    releaseCharacter()
    homeCFrame = nil
    title.Text = "AUTO"
    status.Text = "CLICK TO START"
end

local function heading()
    local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
    return math.atan2(-right.Z, right.X)
end

local function startCycle()
    -- Keep the same physical anchor for the whole mount, not each trick.
    if stabilityHealth then stabilityHealth() end
    baseHeight = root.Position.Y
    targetHeight = baseHeight + liftHeight
    turned = 0
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    setPhase("up", "RISING")
end

local function connectCharacter()
    local character = player.Character
    local newRoot = character
        and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local newHumanoid = character
        and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not newRoot or not newHumanoid
        or newHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    root = newRoot
    humanoid = newHumanoid
    oldAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
    humanoid.AutoRotate = false

    fixedX = root.Position.X
    fixedZ = root.Position.Z
    -- Keep the first valid home point across accidental falls / respawns.
    -- A fresh run resets this value; restarting a character does not.
    if not homeCFrame then
        homeCFrame = root.CFrame
    end
    if newHumanoid.SeatPart then
        -- Recovery checks that this seat is our actual G2 next frame.
        startCycle()
    else
        -- Don't lift/spin the player while looking for the G2 scooter.
        setPhase("recovery", "FINDING G2")
    end
end

local function holdUpright(dt)
    local angle = heading()
    local height = root.Position.Y

    root.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(fixedX, height, fixedZ)
        * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)

    local verticalSpeed = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    -- Cap speed to the remaining distance per physics step. This allows
    -- turbo movement without overshooting the 2-stud travel repeatedly.
    local stepTime = math.max(dt, 1 / 240)

    if phase == "up" then
        verticalSpeed = math.clamp(
            (targetHeight - height) / stepTime, -riseSpeed, riseSpeed
        )
    elseif phase == "spin" then
        -- Preserve the original small stabilization while rotating.
        verticalSpeed = math.clamp(
            (targetHeight - height) * 8, -6, 6
        )
    elseif phase == "down" then
        local distanceDown = height - baseHeight
        if distanceDown > 0.16 then
            verticalSpeed = -math.min(descentSpeed, distanceDown / stepTime)
        else
            verticalSpeed = 0
        end
    end

    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
        0, verticalSpeed, 0
    )
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
        0, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y, 0
    )
end

local function beginLanding()
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    descentObserved = false
    setPhase("down", "LANDING")
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
        0, -descentSpeed, 0
    )
end
