-- STABILITY GUARD (V10): resist horizontal drift without touching vertical
-- motion, spinning, collision flags, vehicle anchoring, or server ownership.
-- The original rider/anti-break logic remains intact. All objects below are
-- local, created only after a real G2 mount, and removed during recovery/OFF.
local guard = {
    root = nil, seat = nil, attachment = nil, align = nil,
    ride = nil, rideAnchor = nil, elapsed = 0, driftTime = 0, peakRideDrift = 0,
    created = 0, failure = nil, lastLog = 0,
    completed = 0, failed = 0, failedInRow = 0, lastCompletedAt = 0,
    sawSpin = false, alerted = false, idle = false
}
local GUARD_DRIFT_ALERT = 2.5  -- alert for large, sustained model movement
local GUARD_DRIFT_SECONDS = 1.5
local GUARD_LOG_EVERY = 30

stabilityHealth = function()
    guard.sawSpin = false
end

releaseStability = function()
    if guard.align then
        pcall(function() guard.align:Destroy() end)
    end
    if guard.attachment then
        pcall(function() guard.attachment:Destroy() end)
    end
    guard.root, guard.seat, guard.ride = nil, nil, nil
    guard.attachment, guard.align, guard.rideAnchor = nil, nil, nil
    guard.driftTime, guard.peakRideDrift, guard.elapsed = 0, 0, 0
end

local function setupStability(seat)
    if not root or root.Anchored or not root.Parent then return end
    releaseStability()
    guard.root, guard.seat = root, seat
    local ride = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local rides = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rides")
    if ride and rides and ride.Parent == rides then
        guard.ride = ride
        guard.rideAnchor = ride:GetPivot().Position
    end
    guard.created = os.clock()

    -- A bounded world-space planar correction. Y-force is exactly zero,
    -- so it cannot fight the 15 studs/sec ascent/descent or jump vertically.
    -- Soft physics control avoids the repeated PivotTo feedback seen in V9.
    local attach, align
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        attach = Instance.new("Attachment")
        attach.Name = "KL_StableXZ_Attachment"
        attach.Parent = root
        align = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
        align.Name = "KL_StableXZ_Planar"
        align.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
        align.Attachment0 = attach
        align.RigidityEnabled = false
        align.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
        align.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
        align.ForceRelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        local force = math.clamp(root.AssemblyMass * 380, 5000, 70000)
        align.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(force, 0, force)
        align.MaxVelocity = 8
        align.Responsiveness = 28
        align.Position = Vector3.new(fixedX, root.Position.Y, fixedZ)
        align.Parent = root
    end)
    if ok then
        guard.attachment, guard.align = attach, align
        guardStatus.Text = "GUARD ON | 0 SUCCESS"
        print("[KL GUARD] Horizontal stabilization active. Vertical force=0.")
    else
        if align then pcall(function() align:Destroy() end) end
        if attach then pcall(function() attach:Destroy() end) end
        guard.failure = tostring(err)
        guardStatus.Text = "GUARD FALLBACK: ROOT LOCK"
        warn("[KL GUARD] Optional planar assist unavailable; V10 root lock remains: ", err)
    end
end

maintainStability = function(dt)
    if not enabled or not root or not humanoid then
        if guard.root then releaseStability() end
        return false
    end
    local seat = ownRideSeat()
    local prompt = seat and seat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    if recoveryActive or phase == "recovery" or not seat
        or not isG2Prompt(prompt) or humanoid.SeatPart ~= seat then
        if guard.root then releaseStability() end
        return false
    end
    if guard.root ~= root or guard.seat ~= seat then
        setupStability(seat)
    end

    -- Read the stabilized rider position after the existing rotation update.
    -- The alignment force has no effect on Y; its target follows current Y.
    if guard.align and guard.align.Parent and guard.align.Attachment0 then
        guard.align.Position = Vector3.new(fixedX, root.Position.Y, fixedZ)
    end

    guard.elapsed += dt
    if guard.elapsed < 0.2 then return false end
    local period = guard.elapsed
    guard.elapsed = 0
    if not guard.rideAnchor or not guard.ride or not guard.ride.Parent then return false end

    -- Measure actual MODEL displacement in world XZ, without confusing
    -- normal yaw/spin with translation. Do not compare world seat position
    -- to a fixed point: the seat may rotate around the scooter pivot.
    local pivot = guard.ride:GetPivot().Position
    local home = guard.rideAnchor
    local drift = (Vector2.new(pivot.X, pivot.Z)
        - Vector2.new(home.X, home.Z)).Magnitude
    guard.peakRideDrift = math.max(guard.peakRideDrift, drift)
    if drift >= GUARD_DRIFT_ALERT then
        guard.driftTime += period
    else
        guard.driftTime = 0
    end
    if guard.driftTime >= GUARD_DRIFT_SECONDS and not guard.alerted then
        guard.alerted = true
        warn(string.format("[KL GUARD] Persistent scooter model drift: %.2f studs. Check seat/physics.", drift))
        notify("G2 DRIFT DETECTED")
    end
    if guard.alerted then
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("G2 DRIFT! PEAK %.2f | OK %d", guard.peakRideDrift, guard.completed)
    else
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("GUARD %s | OK %d | MOVE %.2f", guard.align and "ON" or "FALLBACK", guard.completed, drift)
    end
    if os.clock() - guard.lastLog >= GUARD_LOG_EVERY then
        guard.lastLog = os.clock()
        print(string.format(
            "[KL GUARD] complete=%d failed=%d peak_model_drift=%.2f mounted=%s phase=%s assist=%s",
            guard.completed, guard.failed, guard.peakRideDrift,
            tostring(humanoid.SeatPart == seat), phase, tostring(guard.align ~= nil)
        ))
    end
    return false
end

-- A prolonged lack of rotations is a genuine failure; do not silently
-- report that 10 hours of useful work occurred if the game blocked spinning.
local function flagSpinFailure(reason)
    guard.failed += 1
    guard.failedInRow += 1
    warn(string.format("[KL GUARD] spin failed (%d consecutive): %s", guard.failedInRow, reason))
    if guard.failedInRow >= 3 then
        stop()
        title.Text = "ALERT"
        status.Text = "SPIN BLOCKED - CHECK"
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("0 PROGRESS | SUCCESS %d", guard.completed)
        notify("SPIN BLOCKED")
        return true
    end
    beginLanding()
    return false
end

stabilityWatchdog = function()
    -- Failed spawn/mount/recovery must not run silently for hours.
    -- Reset only after a fully measured 5300-degree spin, not on UI clicks.
    if not enabled then return false end
    if guard.lastCompletedAt > 0 and os.clock() - guard.lastCompletedAt <= 150 then
        return false
    end
    if guard.lastCompletedAt > 0 and os.clock() - guard.lastCompletedAt > 150 then
        stop()
        title.Text = "ALERT"
        status.Text = "NO COMPLETED SPIN"
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("GUARD STOPPED | OK %d", guard.completed)
        notify("AUTO STOPPED - NO SPIN")
        warn("[KL GUARD] No completed spin for 150 seconds: stopped instead of silently idling")
        return true
    end
    return false
end


local function visible(object)
    if not object then return false end
    local current = object
    while current and current ~= playerGui do
        if current:IsA("GuiObject") and not current.Visible then
            return false
        end
        if current:IsA("ScreenGui") and not current.Enabled then
            return false
        end
        current = current.Parent
    end
    return current == playerGui
end

-- SILENT G2 SPAWN: no My Rides opening, no simulated mouse movement.
-- This is a best-effort executor-dependent way to call the *existing*
-- on-click client handler. It does not invent a RemoteEvent or forge an ID.
-- Success is *only* confirmed when the server creates the G2 ride.
local function silentSpawn(button, methodIndex)
    if not button or not button:IsA("GuiButton") then
        return false, "G2 Spawn button not found"
    end

    local methods = {
        {"Activated", "connections"},
        {"MouseButton1Click", "connections"},
        {"MouseButton1Down", "connections"},
        {"Activated", "signal"},
        {"MouseButton1Click", "signal"},
        {"MouseButton1Up", "connections"}
    }

    local entry = methods[(methodIndex - 1) % #methods + 1]
    local eventName, action = entry[1], entry[2]
    local signal = button[eventName]

    if action == "signal" then
        if type(firesignal) ~= "function" then
            return false, "firesignal is unavailable in Medium"
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(firesignal, signal)
        if not ok then
            return false, eventName .. ": " .. tostring(err)
        end
        return true, "firesignal(" .. eventName .. ")"
    end

    if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then
        return false, "getconnections is unavailable in Medium"
    end

    local okConnections, results = pcall(getconnections, signal)
    if not okConnections then
        return false, "getconnections(" .. eventName .. ") failed: " .. tostring(results)
    end

    if type(results) ~= "table" or #results == 0 then
        return false, "No visible " .. eventName .. " callbacks"
    end

    -- One callback at a time so we do not double-spawn/toggle the scooter.
    -- These are executor APIs, not Roblox's supported scripting APIs.
    for _, conn in ipairs(results) do
        local okProps, active, fn, fire = pcall(function()
            return conn.Enabled, conn.Function, conn.Fire
        end)
        if okProps and active ~= false then
            if type(fn) == "function" then
                local ok, err
                if eventName == "Activated" then
                    ok, err = pcall(fn, nil, 1)
                else
                    ok, err = pcall(fn)
                end
                if ok then
                    return true, "callback(" .. eventName .. ")"
                end
                return false, "callback " .. eventName .. " failed: " .. tostring(err)
            elseif type(fire) == "function" then
                local ok, err = pcall(fire, conn)
                if ok then
                    return true, "connection.Fire(" .. eventName .. ")"
                end
                return false, "connection.Fire failed: " .. tostring(err)
            end
        end
    end
    return false, "No callable " .. eventName .. " listener"
end

local function recoveryFailure(message)
    -- A failed attempt must NOT turn AUTO OFF.
    -- Retry with a cooldown, so an obscured UI does not get spam-clicked.
    if recoveryPrompt then
        pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
    end
    recoveryPrompt = nil
    recoveryFailures += 1
    recoveryRetryAt = os.clock() + math.min(15, 3 + recoveryFailures * 2)
    recoveryActive = false
    recoveryElapsed = 0
    recoveryCooldown = 0
    travelAttempts = 0
    returnAttempts = 0
    spawnAttempts = 0
    recoveryReturned = false
    stageGroundY = nil
    stagePhase = "none"
    stageElapsed = 0
    stageFinalStable = 0
    stageAttempts = 0
    status.Text = "RECOVERY RETRY"
    warn("[AUTO RECOVERY] " .. tostring(message)
        .. " | attempt " .. recoveryFailures
        .. " | retry pending; AUTO stays ON")
end

local function moveCharacterTo(destination)
    local character = player.Character
    local transform = destination * root.CFrame:Inverse()
    character:PivotTo(transform * character:GetPivot())
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Ground-aware recovery: use the actual lowest collidable scooter part,
-- not the character's original Y. This prevents the wheels from being
-- placed through the ground when the G2 is spawned elsewhere.
local FINAL_GROUND_CLEARANCE = 0.55
local INITIAL_CLEARANCE = 1.25  -- one safe placement; gravity handles descent
local SETTLE_OBSERVE = 0.30
local SETTLE_LIMIT = 1.8
local MIN_RIDE_PARTS = 15

local function getRideBottom(ride)
    local lowest = math.huge
    local collidable = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(ride:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
            local frame, size = p.CFrame, p.Size
            local halfVertical = (
                math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X
                + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y
                + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z
            ) * 0.5
            lowest = math.min(lowest, p.Position.Y - halfVertical)
            collidable += 1
        end
    end
    if collidable == 0 then
        -- Some vehicle games turn all collisions off temporarily.
        -- In that case use the model bounds only as a fallback.
        local frame, size = ride:GetBoundingBox()
        local halfVertical = (
            math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X
            + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y
            + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z
        ) * 0.5
        lowest = frame.Position.Y - halfVertical
    end
    return lowest
end

local function raycastFloorAt(worldPos, ride)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ride, player.Character}
    params.RespectCanCollide = true
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local highest = nil
    -- Nearby samples help avoid sinking on slightly uneven terrain.
    for _, offset in ipairs({
        Vector3.zero,
        Vector3.new(1.2, 0, 0),
        Vector3.new(-1.2, 0, 0),
        Vector3.new(0, 0, 1.2),
        Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.2)
    }) do
        local origin = worldPos + offset + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -140, 0), params)
        if hit and (not highest or hit.Position.Y > highest) then
            highest = hit.Position.Y
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function moveRideAndRider(ride, delta)
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.001 then return end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not root or not root.Parent then return end
    local beforeRoot = root.Position
    local beforeCharacterPivot = character:GetPivot()
    -- A welded rider may move together with the ride. Reposition the
    -- character only by the REMAINING displacement to avoid double-moving.
    ride:PivotTo(CFrame.new(delta) * ride:GetPivot())
    local remaining = beforeRoot + delta - root.Position
    if remaining.Magnitude > 0.03 then
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(remaining) * character:GetPivot())
    end
    -- Keep landing gradual and prevent old fall/spin velocity carrying over.
    local currentSeat = ownRideSeat()
    if currentSeat then
        currentSeat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        currentSeat.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

local function returnRideHome(seat)
    local ride = childPath(workspace, {"Rides", "Ride_" .. player.Name})
    if not ride or not ride:IsA("Model") then
        return false, "Own ride model is unavailable"
    end
    if humanoid.SeatPart ~= seat or not homeCFrame then
        return false, "Mounting must be confirmed before returning"
    end
    local count = 0
    for _, item in ipairs(ride:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then count += 1 end
    end
    if count < MIN_RIDE_PARTS then
        return false, "G2 model has not finished loading"
    end
    local home = homeCFrame.Position
    local floorY = raycastFloorAt(home, ride)
    if not floorY then
        return false, "Could not locate solid ground at saved position"
    end
    local ok, message = pcall(function()
        local bottomY = getRideBottom(ride)
        local desiredBottomY = floorY + FINAL_GROUND_CLEARANCE + INITIAL_CLEARANCE
        local delta = Vector3.new(
            home.X - root.Position.X,
            desiredBottomY - bottomY,
            home.Z - root.Position.Z
        )
        moveRideAndRider(ride, delta)
    end)
    if ok then
        print(string.format(
            "[G2 V10] One-time placement, bottom %.2f studs above floor. Letting physics settle.",
            INITIAL_CLEARANCE + FINAL_GROUND_CLEARANCE
        ))
    end
    return ok, message, floorY
end

local function recoverRide(dt)
    local candidateSeat = ownRideSeat()
    local candidatePrompt = candidateSeat
        and candidateSeat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    local seatIsG2 = isG2Prompt(candidatePrompt)
    -- G4 Pro may already exist: only a confirmed G2 counts as ready.
    local seat = seatIsG2 and candidateSeat or nil
    local mounted = seat and humanoid.SeatPart == seat
    if seatIsG2 and not recoveryG2Seen then
        print("[G2 DETECT] Own G2 found; EnterPrompt=" .. tostring(candidatePrompt.ObjectText))
        recoveryG2Seen = true
        -- Remember which silent input method worked for the next start.
        if environment and lastInvokedSpawnMethod then
            environment.SpinStudioG2PreferredMethod = lastInvokedSpawnMethod
            print("[G2 V10] Cached successful spawn method:", lastInvokedSpawnMethod)
        end
    elseif not seatIsG2 then
        recoveryG2Seen = false
    end
    if mounted and not recoveryMountedSeen then
        print("[G2 AUTO] G2 SEAT CONFIRMED")
        recoveryMountedSeen = true
    elseif not mounted then
        recoveryMountedSeen = false
    end

    -- A disconnected SeatPart means the rider is no longer actually seated.
    -- Remove the local retention weld BEFORE attempting to travel/reattach.
    if not mounted and releaseRiderLock then
        releaseRiderLock()
    end

    -- Manual-spawn mode: once the player is actually seated on their G2,
    -- spin must not wait for the automated spawn/recovery sequence.
    -- In particular, phase may still be "recovery" after a manual mount.
    if mounted and not autoSpawn then
        if recoveryActive then
            cancelRecovery()
        end
        recoveryFailures = 0
        recoveryRetryAt = 0
        if phase == "recovery" or phase == "off" then
            fixedX = root.Position.X
            fixedZ = root.Position.Z
            startCycle()
            print("[G2 V10 MANUAL] Manual G2 mount confirmed. Spinning started.")
        end
        return false
    end

    if mounted and not recoveryActive then
        recoveryFailures = 0
        recoveryRetryAt = 0
        return false
    end

    if not mounted and os.clock() < recoveryRetryAt then
        status.Text = "RECOVERY RETRY"
        return true
    end

    if not recoveryActive then
        recoveryActive = true
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        recoveryStable = 0
        recoveryCooldown = 0
        spawnAttempts = 0
        uiClickAttempts = 0
        recoveryTravelled = false
        recoveryReturned = false
        stageGroundY = nil
        stagePhase = "none"
        stageElapsed = 0
        stageFinalStable = 0
        stageAttempts = 0
        travelAttempts = 0
        returnAttempts = 0
        phase = "recovery"
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0
        )
        local angle = heading()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
    end

    recoveryCooldown = math.max(0, recoveryCooldown - dt)
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    if mounted then
        if recoveryPrompt then
            pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
            recoveryPrompt = nil
        end

        -- Initial spawn or post-fall: ONE ground-aware placement only.
        -- Unlike V9, do not force hover height every physics frame.
        if not recoveryReturned then
            if recoveryCooldown > 0 then return true end
            if returnAttempts >= 3 then
                recoveryFailure("Could not place G2 safely")
                return true
            end
            status.Text = "POSITIONING G2"
            local ok, message, floorY = returnRideHome(seat)
            if not ok then
                returnAttempts += 1
                recoveryCooldown = 0.25
                if returnAttempts >= 3 then
                    recoveryFailure(message)
                end
                return true
            end
            returnAttempts += 1
            recoveryReturned = true
            stageGroundY = floorY
            stagePhase = "settle"
            stageElapsed = 0
            stageFinalStable = 0
            recoveryCooldown = 0.10
            print("[G2 V10] Placement complete. No repeated hover/landing teleports.")
            return true
        end

        if recoveryCooldown > 0 then return true end
        local ride = childPath(workspace, {"Rides", "Ride_" .. player.Name})
        if not ride or not seat:IsDescendantOf(ride) then
            recoveryFailure("Own G2 disappeared during seat check")
            return true
        end

        stageElapsed += dt
        status.Text = "CHECKING SEAT"
        local stillMounted = humanoid.SeatPart == seat
        local upright = root.CFrame.UpVector.Y >= 0.55
        -- Only observe clearance; never repeatedly move the ride to chase it.
        local floorGap = getRideBottom(ride) - stageGroundY
        local noGroundPenetration = floorGap >= -0.55

        if stillMounted and upright and noGroundPenetration then
            stageFinalStable += dt
        else
            stageFinalStable = 0
        end

        if stageFinalStable >= SETTLE_OBSERVE then
            fixedX = root.Position.X
            fixedZ = root.Position.Z
            cancelRecovery()
            recoveryFailures = 0
            recoveryRetryAt = 0
            notify("RIDE CONFIRMED")
            print("[G2 V10] Seat confirmed, AUTO SPIN STARTED")
            startCycle()  -- Critical: no second AUTO press required.
            return true
        end

        if stageElapsed > SETTLE_LIMIT then
            if stillMounted and noGroundPenetration and upright then
                -- Valid seat but small physics vibration: don't deadlock here.
                warn("[G2 V10] Settle timeout; seat valid. Starting spin.")
                fixedX = root.Position.X
                fixedZ = root.Position.Z
                cancelRecovery()
                recoveryFailures = 0
                recoveryRetryAt = 0
                startCycle()
            else
                -- Avoid a perpetual PivotTo loop if the server disagrees.
                recoveryFailure(string.format(
                    "Safe mount unconfirmed (mounted=%s, upright=%s, floorGap=%.2f)",
                    tostring(stillMounted), tostring(upright), floorGap
                ))
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    recoveryStable = 0

    if not autoEquip and recoveryPrompt then
        pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
        recoveryPrompt = nil
    end

    -- שתי האפשרויות כבויות: מחכה לעלייה ידנית
    if not autoSpawn and not autoEquip then
        status.Text = "MOUNT RIDE TO CONTINUE"
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        return true
    end

    -- זימון בלבד אינו מפעיל E
    if seat and not autoEquip then
        status.Text = "RIDE READY - PRESS E"
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        return true
    end

    if not seat and not autoSpawn then
        status.Text = "NO LOADED RIDE - SPAWN IT"
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        return true
    end

    recoveryElapsed = recoveryElapsed + dt
    if recoveryElapsed > 30 then
        recoveryFailure("Could not confirm recovery within 30 seconds")
        return true
    end

    if recoveryPrompt then
        recoveryHold = recoveryHold - dt
        if not recoveryPrompt.Parent or recoveryHold <= 0 then
            pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
            recoveryPrompt = nil
            recoveryCooldown = 1
        end
        return true
    end
    if recoveryCooldown > 0 then return true end

    local prompt = seat and seat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    if autoEquip and isG2Prompt(prompt) then
        if not prompt.Enabled then
            status.Text = "WAITING FOR ENTER"
            return true
        end

        local allowedRange = math.min(10, prompt.MaxActivationDistance)
        if allowedRange <= 0 then
            recoveryFailure("Enter prompt has no usable activation range")
            return true
        end
        local distance = (seat.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        if distance > allowedRange then
            if travelAttempts >= 3 then
                recoveryFailure("Could not reach the loaded scooter")
                return true
            end
            status.Text = "GOING TO SCOOTER"
            local offset = math.min(3, allowedRange * 0.5)
            local target = seat.Position + seat.CFrame.RightVector * offset
            target = target + Vector3.new(0, math.min(1, allowedRange * 0.2), 0)
            local ok, message = pcall(function()
                moveCharacterTo(CFrame.new(target) * CFrame.Angles(0, heading(), 0))
            end)
            if not ok then recoveryFailure(message); return true end
            travelAttempts = travelAttempts + 1
            recoveryTravelled = true
            recoveryReturned = false
            recoveryCooldown = 0.5
            return true
        end

        status.Text = "ENTERING G2"
        recoveryPrompt = prompt
        recoveryHold = prompt.HoldDuration + 0.15
        recoveryTravelled = true
        recoveryReturned = false
        local ok, message = pcall(function()
            if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                print("[G2 AUTO] EnterPrompt triggered; waiting for actual seating")
                recoveryHold = 0.2
            else
                prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                print("[G2 AUTO] EnterPrompt hold started; waiting for seating")
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            recoveryPrompt = nil
            recoveryFailure("Enter prompt could not be activated: " .. tostring(message))
        end
        return true
    end

    if seat then
        status.Text = "WAITING FOR G2 ENTER"
        return true
    end
    if not autoSpawn then return true end

    -- מוצא את כרטיס G2 לפי הכותרת המוצגת, בלי לנחש שם פנימי
    local rideList = childPath(playerGui, {
        "MainUi", "Rides", "Frame", "CanvasGroup", "ScrollingFrame"
    })
    local spawnButton
    if rideList then
        local g2 = rideList:FindFirstChild("ScooterG2")
        local knownSpawn = g2 and g2:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
        if knownSpawn and knownSpawn:IsA("GuiButton") then
            spawnButton = knownSpawn
        end
    end
    if rideList and not spawnButton then
        for _, item in ipairs(rideList:GetDescendants()) do
            if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton"))
                and (item.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") == "G2"
                    or item.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") == "Kuki G2") then
                local card = item.Parent
                while card and card ~= rideList do
                    local candidate = card:FindFirstChild("Spawn", true)
                    if candidate and candidate:IsA("GuiButton") then
                        spawnButton = candidate
                        break
                    end
                    card = card.Parent
                end
                if spawnButton then break end
            end
        end
    end
    -- No opening My Rides. The user may open it manually if the game
    -- requires the panel to be active, but we NEVER click or show it.
    if not spawnButton then
        status.Text = "G2 SPAWN BUTTON NOT FOUND"
        recoveryCooldown = 1
        return true
    end

    if spawnAttempts >= 6 then
        recoveryFailure("Silent spawn methods exhausted without a confirmed G2. "
            .. "See [G2 SILENT] lines; server/UI restrictions may apply.")
        return true
    end

    if os.clock() - uiLastClick < 0.90 then
        return true
    end

    local preferred = environment and environment.SpinStudioG2PreferredMethod
    local order = {}
    if type(preferred) == "number" and preferred >= 1 and preferred <= 6 then
        table.insert(order, preferred)
    end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        if i ~= preferred then table.insert(order, i) end
    end

    -- If an executor method isn't supported, immediately try the next.
    -- After any actual callback returns successfully, wait for the server
    -- to create the G2 before attempting another method.
    while spawnAttempts < 6 do
        local index = order[spawnAttempts + 1]
        spawnAttempts += 1
        local ok, message = silentSpawn(spawnButton, index)
        if ok then
            lastInvokedSpawnMethod = index
            uiLastClick = os.clock()
            recoveryCooldown = 0.90
            status.Text = "VERIFYING G2 SPAWN"
            print(string.format(
                "[G2 SILENT] Method %d/6 called: %s; waiting for G2",
                index, message
            ))
            return true
        end
        warn(string.format(
            "[G2 SILENT] Method %d unavailable: %s (immediate fallback)",
            index, message
        ))
    end

    recoveryFailure("No silent G2 spawn method is available")
    return true
end

-- RIDER LOCK: preserve the rider's attachment to the scooter seat.
-- No anchoring; no changes to spinning speed or existing Anti-Break corrections.
-- A local WeldConstraint may be overridden by the game/server; it is not
-- a guarantee of server-side seating or replication.
local riderLock = {
    seat = nil,
    humanoid = nil,
    character = nil,
    weld = nil,
    jumpAllowed = nil
}

releaseRiderLock = function()
    if riderLock.weld then
        pcall(function() riderLock.weld:Destroy() end)
    end
    if riderLock.humanoid and riderLock.humanoid.Parent then
        pcall(function()
            if riderLock.jumpAllowed ~= nil then
                riderLock.humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
                    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, riderLock.jumpAllowed
                )
            end
        end)
    end
    riderLock.seat = nil
    riderLock.humanoid = nil
    riderLock.character = nil
    riderLock.weld = nil
    riderLock.jumpAllowed = nil
end

maintainRiderLock = function()
    if not enabled then return end
    local char = player.Character
    local human = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not human or not hrp or human.Health <= 0 then
        releaseRiderLock()
        return
    end

    if riderLock.character and riderLock.character ~= char then
        releaseRiderLock()
    end

    -- Never retain a stale weld after dismount. The recovery routine
    -- needs to move the character independently of the scooter.
    if riderLock.seat and human.SeatPart ~= riderLock.seat then
        releaseRiderLock()
    end

    -- Only attach after the player is actually sitting on their own scooter.
    if not riderLock.seat then
        local currentSeat = human.SeatPart
        local ownSeat = ownRideSeat()
        if not currentSeat or currentSeat ~= ownSeat then return end
        local enter = currentSeat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
        if not isG2Prompt(enter) then return end

        riderLock.character = char
        riderLock.humanoid = human
        riderLock.seat = currentSeat
        riderLock.jumpAllowed = human:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Name = "SpinStudio_RiderLock_Local"
        weld.Part0 = currentSeat
        weld.Part1 = hrp
        weld.Parent = hrp
        riderLock.weld = weld
        human:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
        print("[SPIN+LOCK] Rider retention ON")
    end

    if riderLock.weld and not riderLock.weld.Parent then
        -- The game may remove a local constraint; don't silently claim success.
        riderLock.weld = nil
        warn("[SPIN+LOCK] Rider weld removed; cannot guarantee retention")
    end
    if human.SeatPart == riderLock.seat then
        human.Jump = false
    end
end

-- ANTI-BREAK V1: relative assembly correction (no Anchored).
-- Automatically tracks the player's scooter and restarts if it changes.
local LOCK_INTERVAL = 1 / 30
local LOCK_THRESHOLD = 3
local LOCK_MAX_GROUPS = 6
local lockState = {
    scooter = nil, seat = nil, groups = {},
    corrections = 0, peakError = 0, accumulator = 0
}

local function clearLock()
    lockState.scooter = nil
    lockState.seat = nil
    lockState.groups = {}
    lockState.accumulator = 0
end

local function frontPart(part, vehicle)
    local node = part
    while node and node ~= vehicle do
        if node.Name == "SuspensionFixed"
            or node.Name == "SuspensionGeometry"
            or node.Name == "HandGoals" then
            return true
        end
        node = node.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function startLock()
    local char = player.Character
    local human = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local currentSeat = human and human.SeatPart
    local rides = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rides")

    if not currentSeat or not rides or currentSeat ~= ownRideSeat() then return end
    local enter = currentSeat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    if not isG2Prompt(enter) then return end

    local vehicle = currentSeat
    while vehicle and vehicle.Parent ~= rides do
        vehicle = vehicle.Parent
    end
    if not vehicle or vehicle.Parent ~= rides then return end

    if lockState.seat == currentSeat
        and lockState.scooter == vehicle then return end

    clearLock()
    lockState.seat = currentSeat
    lockState.scooter = vehicle

    local seatRoot = currentSeat.AssemblyRootPart
    local seen = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(vehicle:GetDescendants()) do
        if #lockState.groups >= LOCK_MAX_GROUPS then break end
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and frontPart(part, vehicle) then
            local assemblyRoot = part.AssemblyRootPart
            if assemblyRoot and assemblyRoot ~= seatRoot
                and assemblyRoot:IsDescendantOf(vehicle)
                and not seen[assemblyRoot] then
                seen[assemblyRoot] = true
                table.insert(lockState.groups, {
                    root = assemblyRoot,
                    offset = currentSeat.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(assemblyRoot.CFrame)
                })
            end
        end
    end
    print(string.format("[SPIN+LOCK] Saved %d assemblies", #lockState.groups))
end

-- Separate update loop: keeps the exact V1 correction policy.
table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not alive or not enabled then return end
    -- Avoid rider weld / anti-break CFrame corrections while moving a newly
    -- spawned G2 into position. This removes the main V9 feedback loop.
    if recoveryActive or phase == "recovery" then
        clearLock()
        return
    end
    maintainRiderLock()
    if not lockState.seat
        or not lockState.seat:IsDescendantOf(lockState.scooter)
        or not player.Character
        or not player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        or (player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").SeatPart ~= lockState.seat
            and riderLock.seat ~= lockState.seat) then
        clearLock()
        startLock()
    end

    local currentSeat = lockState.seat
    local vehicle = lockState.scooter
    if not currentSeat or not vehicle then return end
    lockState.accumulator += dt
    if lockState.accumulator < LOCK_INTERVAL then return end
    lockState.accumulator = 0

    local seatRoot = currentSeat.AssemblyRootPart
    for _, group in ipairs(lockState.groups) do
        local assemblyRoot = group.root
        if assemblyRoot:IsDescendantOf(vehicle)
            and not assemblyRoot.Anchored
            and assemblyRoot.AssemblyRootPart == assemblyRoot
            and assemblyRoot ~= seatRoot then
            local target = currentSeat.CFrame * group.offset

    if not enabled then return end

    if not root or not humanoid then
        connectCharacter()
        return
    end

    if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent
        or humanoid.Health <= 0
        or root.Parent ~= player.Character then

        releaseCharacter()
        status.Text = "WAITING FOR CHARACTER"
        return
    end

    if recoverRide(dt) then
        if releaseStability then releaseStability() end
        return
    end

    if maintainStability then maintainStability(dt) end
    elapsed = elapsed + dt
    local verticalVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    holdUpright(dt)

    if phase == "up" then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        if math.abs(root.Position.Y - targetHeight) < 0.3 then
            turned = 0
            previousAngle = heading()
            setPhase("spin", "SPINNING")
        elseif elapsed > 5 then
            beginLanding()
        end

    elseif phase == "spin" then
        local angle = heading()
        local difference = angle - previousAngle
        local delta = math.atan2(
            math.sin(difference),
            math.cos(difference)
        )

        turned = turned + math.deg(delta)
        previousAngle = angle
        local remaining = targetDegrees - turned

        status.Text = string.format(
            "%.0f / %d", turned, targetDegrees
        )

        if math.abs(turned) >= 60 then guard.sawSpin = true end
        if remaining <= 0.1 then
            guard.completed += 1
            guard.lastCompletedAt = os.clock()
            guard.failedInRow = 0
            guard.sawSpin = false
            beginLanding()
            return
        end
        if (elapsed >= 4 and not guard.sawSpin) or elapsed > 15 then
            flagSpinFailure(elapsed > 15 and "15s spin timeout" or "no measured yaw after 4s")
            return
        end

        local stepTime = math.max(dt, 1 / 240)
        local speed = math.min(
            maxSpeed,
            remaining * finishResponse,
            remaining / stepTime,
            90 / stepTime
        )

        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
            0, math.rad(speed), 0
        )

    elseif phase == "down" then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        -- With turbo descent, touchdown can happen in 1-2 physics steps.
        -- The old 0.15-second settle detection slowed every loop considerably.
        if root.Position.Y <= baseHeight + 0.24 then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            setPhase("wait", "NEXT ROUND")
        else
            if verticalVelocity < -2 then
                descentObserved = true
            end
            -- Backup: ground collision may stop us a little above baseHeight.
            if math.abs(verticalVelocity) < 1
                and (descentObserved or elapsed >= 0.06) then
                stableTime = stableTime + dt
            else
                stableTime = 0
            end

            if stableTime >= 0.03 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                setPhase("wait", "NEXT ROUND")
            elseif elapsed > 3 then
                setPhase("wait", "RETRYING")
            end
        end

    elseif phase == "wait" then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        if elapsed >= waitTime then
            startCycle()
        end
    end
end))

    if not obj:IsA("Model") and not obj:IsA("BasePart") then

    if Highlights[category][obj] then
        return
    end

    local isMonster = category == "Twisteds ESP"

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "NeonHub_ESP"
    highlight.Adornee = obj
    highlight.FillTransparency = 1
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

    highlight.OutlineColor = isMonster
        and Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 35)
        or Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)

    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = Gui

    local tag

    if category ~= "Items ESP" then
        tag = CreateNameTag(obj)
    end

    Highlights[category][obj] = {
        Highlight = highlight,
        Tag = tag
    }
end

-- CLEANUP
--==================================================

    for obj, data in pairs(Highlights[category]) do
        if data.Highlight then
            data.Highlight:Destroy()
        end

        if data.Tag then
            data.Tag:Destroy()
        end
    end

    Highlights[category] = {}
end

--==================================================

--==================================================

local function ContainsKeyword(name, keywords)
    name = name:lower()

    for _, keyword in ipairs(keywords) do
        if name:find(keyword, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function IsMonsterModel(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("Model") then
        return false
    end

    local current = obj
    local folderFound = false
    local nameFound = false

    while current and current ~= Workspace do
        local name = current.Name:lower()

        -- EXCLUSIONS

        if ContainsKeyword(name, ExcludedNames) then
            return false
        end

        -- MONSTER FOLDER DETECTION

        if ContainsKeyword(name, MonsterFolders) then
            folderFound = true
        end

        -- MONSTER NAME DETECTION

        if current:IsA("Model")
            and ContainsKeyword(name, MonsterKeywords) then
            nameFound = true
        end

        current = current.Parent
    end

    return folderFound or nameFound
end

local function ScanTwistedMonsters()
    local category = "Twisteds ESP"

    if not Enabled[category] then
        return
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if IsMonsterModel(obj) then
            AddHighlight(obj, category)
        end
    end
end

--==================================================
-- GENERAL MATCHING
--==================================================

local function MatchesCategory(obj, category)
    local settings = Categories[category]

    if not settings or not settings.keywords then
        return false
    end

    local name = obj.Name:lower()

    for _, keyword in ipairs(settings.keywords) do
        if name:find(keyword, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP
--==================================================

local function ScanPlayers()
    local category = "Players ESP"

    if not Enabled[category] then
        return
    end

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= Player and otherPlayer.Character then
            AddHighlight(otherPlayer.Character, category)
        end
    end
end

--==================================================
-- GENERAL SCANNING
--==================================================

local function ScanCategory(category)
    if not Enabled[category] then
        return
    end

    if category == "Twisteds ESP" then
        ScanTwistedMonsters()
        return
    end

    if category == "Players ESP" then
        ScanPlayers()
        return
    end

    local function Scan(container)
        for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if MatchesCategory(obj, category) then
                AddHighlight(obj, category)
            end
        end
    end

    Scan(Workspace)
    Scan(ReplicatedStorage)
end

    Track(button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Enabled[category] = not Enabled[category]

        if Enabled[category] then

local Janitor = {}
Janitor.__index = Janitor

function Janitor.new()
	return setmetatable({ _tasks = {} :: { any } }, Janitor)
end

function Janitor:Add<T>(taskObj: T): T
	table.insert(self._tasks, taskObj)
	return taskObj
end

function Janitor:Cleanup()
	for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do
		local taskObj = self._tasks[i]
		self._tasks[i] = nil
		if typeof(taskObj) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			taskObj:Disconnect()
		elseif typeof(taskObj) == "Instance" then
			taskObj:Destroy()
		elseif type(taskObj) == "function" then
			taskObj()
		elseif type(taskObj) == "table" and type(taskObj.Destroy) == "function" then
			taskObj:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

type FrameSlot = {
	timestamp: number,
	cframes: { [number]: CFrame },
}

local ReplayBuffer = {}
ReplayBuffer.__index = ReplayBuffer

function ReplayBuffer.new(capacity: number)
	local slots = table.create(capacity) :: { FrameSlot }
	for i = 1, capacity do
		slots[i] = {
			timestamp = 0,
			cframes = {},
		}
	end
	return setmetatable({
		_capacity = capacity,
		_slots = slots,
		_head = 0,
		_count = 0,
	}, ReplayBuffer)
end

function ReplayBuffer:Clear()
	self._head = 0
	self._count = 0
	for i = 1, self._capacity do
		self._slots[i].timestamp = 0
		table.clear(self._slots[i].cframes)
	end
end

function ReplayBuffer:Push(timestamp: number, trackedParts: { BasePart })
	self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
	if self._count < self._capacity then
		self._count += 1
	end

	local slot = self._slots[self._head]
	slot.timestamp = timestamp
	local cfMap = slot.cframes
	table.clear(cfMap)

	for partId, part in ipairs(trackedParts) do
		if part.Parent ~= nil then
			cfMap[partId] = part.CFrame
		end
	end
end

function ReplayBuffer:GetWindowFrames(windowSec: number): { FrameSlot }
	if self._count == 0 then
		return {}
	end

	local newestSlot = self._slots[self._head]
	local cutoffTime = newestSlot.timestamp - windowSec
	local result = {}

	local startOffset = self._count - 1
	for offset = startOffset, 0, -1 do
		local idx = ((self._head - 1 - offset) % self._capacity) + 1
		local slot = self._slots[idx]
		if slot.timestamp >= cutoffTime then
			table.insert(result, slot)
		end
	end

	return result
end

function ReplayBuffer:GetCount(): number
	return self._count
end

GhostVisualizer.__index = GhostVisualizer

function GhostVisualizer:_EnsureFolders()
	if not self._rootFolder or not self._rootFolder.Parent then
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "_HilosHAX_GhostVisuals"
		folder.Parent = workspace

	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:BuildGhostFromParts(trackedParts: { BasePart }, rootPartId: number)
	self:ClearGhost()
	self:_EnsureFolders()
	self._rootPartId = rootPartId

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "HilosHAX_GhostRig"

	for partId, srcPart in ipairs(trackedParts) do
		local ghostPart: BasePart? = nil

		local ok, cloned = pcall(function()
			local prevArchivable = srcPart.Archivable
			srcPart.Archivable = true
			local c = srcPart:Clone()
			srcPart.Archivable = prevArchivable
			return c
		end)

		if ok and cloned and cloned:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, child in ipairs(cloned:GetChildren()) do
				if not (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("DataModelMesh")) then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			ghostPart = cloned
		else
			local fallback = Instance.new("Part")
			fallback.Size = srcPart.Size
			fallback.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
			ghostPart = fallback
		end

		if ghostPart then
			local isInvisibleRoot = (srcPart.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and srcPart.Transparency >= 0.99)
			ghostPart.Name = "Ghost_" .. tostring(partId)
			ghostPart.Anchored = true
			ghostPart.CanCollide = false
			ghostPart.CanTouch = false
			ghostPart.CanQuery = false
			ghostPart.CastShadow = false
			ghostPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			ghostPart.Color = CONFIG.GHOST_COLOR
			ghostPart.Transparency = if isInvisibleRoot then 1 else CONFIG.GHOST_TRANSPARENCY
			ghostPart.CFrame = srcPart.CFrame
			ghostPart.Parent = model

			self._ghostParts[partId] = ghostPart
		end
	end

	model.Parent = self._rootFolder
	self._ghostModel = model
end

function GhostVisualizer:RenderPathTrail(frames: { FrameSlot }, rootPartId: number)
	self:ClearPath()
	if not self._showPath or #frames < 2 then
		return
	end
	self:_EnsureFolders()

	local prevPos: Vector3? = nil
	local step = math.max(1, CONFIG.PATH_NODE_INTERVAL)

	for i = 1, #frames, step do
		local cf = frames[i].cframes[rootPartId]
		if cf then
			local pos = cf.Position
			if prevPos then
				local dist = (pos - prevPos).Magnitude
				if dist > 0.05 then
					local seg = Instance.new("Part")
					seg.Name = "PathSeg"
					seg.Anchored = true
					seg.CanCollide = false
					seg.CanTouch = false
					seg.CanQuery = false
					seg.CastShadow = false
					seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					seg.Color = CONFIG.GHOST_ACCENT
					seg.Transparency = 0.45
					seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, dist)
					seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(prevPos:Lerp(pos, 0.5), pos)
					seg.Parent = self._pathFolder
				end
			end
			prevPos = pos
		end
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:StartPlayback(frames: { FrameSlot }, trackedParts: { BasePart }, rootPartId: number)
	if #frames < 2 then
		return false
	end

	self:BuildGhostFromParts(trackedParts, rootPartId)
	self._frames = frames
	self._elapsed = 0
	self._duration = math.max(0.001, frames[#frames].timestamp - frames[1].timestamp)
	self._isPlaying = true

	self:RenderPathTrail(frames, rootPartId)
	self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(0)
	return true
end

function GhostVisualizer:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha: number)
	local frames = self._frames
	local count = #frames
	if count < 2 then
		return
	end

	alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
	local startTime = frames[1].timestamp
	local targetTime = startTime + (self._duration * alpha)

	local lo = 1
	local hi = count
	while hi - lo > 1 do
		local mid = math.floor((lo + hi) / 2)
		if frames[mid].timestamp <= targetTime then
			lo = mid
		else
			hi = mid
		end
	end

	local frameA = frames[lo]
	local frameB = frames[hi]
	local span = frameB.timestamp - frameA.timestamp
	local t = if span > 0.0001 then math.clamp((targetTime - frameA.timestamp) / span, 0, 1) else 0

	for partId, ghostPart in pairs(self._ghostParts) do
		local cfA = frameA.cframes[partId]
		local cfB = frameB.cframes[partId]
		if cfA and cfB then
			ghostPart.CFrame = cfA:Lerp(cfB, t)
		elseif cfA then
			ghostPart.CFrame = cfA
		elseif cfB then
			ghostPart.CFrame = cfB
		end
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:Step(dt: number)
	if not self._isPlaying or #self._frames < 2 then
		return
	end

	self._elapsed += dt * self._playbackSpeed
	local alpha = self._elapsed / self._duration

	if alpha >= 1 then
		if self._isLooping then
			self._elapsed = self._elapsed % self._duration
			alpha = self._elapsed / self._duration
		else
			alpha = 1
			self._isPlaying = false
			self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha)
			if self._onProgress then
				self._onProgress(1)
			end
			if self._onFinished then
				self._onFinished()
			end
			return
		end
	end

	self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha)
	if self._onProgress then
		self._onProgress(alpha)
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:Scrub(alpha: number)
	if #self._frames < 2 then
		return
	end
	self._elapsed = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1) * self._duration
	self:ApplyFrameAtProgress(alpha)
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetPlaying(playing: boolean)
	self._isPlaying = playing
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetLooping(looping: boolean)
	self._isLooping = looping
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetShowPath(show: boolean)
	self._showPath = show
	if not show then
		self:ClearPath()
	elseif #self._frames >= 2 then
		self:RenderPathTrail(self._frames, self._rootPartId)
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:SetSpeed(speed: number)
	self._playbackSpeed = math.clamp(speed, 0.1, 4.0)
end

function GhostVisualizer:ClearGhost()
	self._isPlaying = false
	table.clear(self._ghostParts)
	if self._ghostModel then
		self._ghostModel:Destroy()
		self._ghostModel = nil
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:ClearPath()
	if self._pathFolder then
		self._pathFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	end
end

function GhostVisualizer:Destroy()
	self:ClearGhost()
	self:ClearPath()
	if self._rootFolder then
		self._rootFolder:Destroy()
		self._rootFolder = nil
	end
end

local function tween(obj: Instance, props: { [string]: any }, duration: number?)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, info, props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function addCorner(parent: Instance, radius: number)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local function addStroke(parent: Instance, color: Color3, transparency: number, thickness: number?)

	stroke.Color = color
	stroke.Transparency = transparency
	stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Parent = parent
	return stroke
end

local function bindCharacter(character: Model)
	CharJanitor:Cleanup()
	table.clear(state.trackedParts)
	buffer:Clear()

	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not character.Parent then
		return
	end

	table.clear(state.trackedParts)
	state.rootPartId = 1

	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(state.trackedParts, desc)
			if desc == hrp or desc.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
				state.rootPartId = #state.trackedParts
			end
		end
	end

	CharJanitor:Add(character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(state.trackedParts, desc)
		end
	end))

	CharJanitor:Add(character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(desc)
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			local idx = table.find(state.trackedParts, desc)
			if idx then
				table.remove(state.trackedParts, idx)
			end
		end
	end))
end

	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 48, 72)
	track.Text = ""
	track.AutoButtonColor = false
	track.Parent = container
	addCorner(track, 3)

	local initAlpha = math.clamp((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(initAlpha, 0, 1, 0)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = CONFIG.UI_ACCENT_LIGHT
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	addCorner(fill, 3)

	local dragging = false
	local function updateFromInput(inputPos: Vector3)
		local relX = math.clamp((inputPos.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
		local val = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * relX
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0)
		valLbl.Text = string.format("%.2f%s", val, suffix)
		onChanged(val)
	end

	track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			updateFromInput(input.Position)
		end
	end)

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			updateFromInput(input.Position)
		end
	end))

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))

	return {
		SetVisual = function(alpha: number)
			if not dragging then
				alpha = math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
				fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
				local val = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * alpha
				valLbl.Text = string.format("%.2f%s", val, suffix)
			end
		end,
	}
end

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end))

	AppJanitor:Add(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
end

AppJanitor:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	if state.isRecording and #state.trackedParts > 0 then
		state.sampleAccumulator += dt
		if state.sampleAccumulator >= SAMPLE_INTERVAL then
			state.sampleAccumulator %= SAMPLE_INTERVAL
			buffer:Push(os.clock(), state.trackedParts)
		end
	end

	telemetryLabel.Text = string.format(
		"REC: %s | FRAMES: %d/%d | PARTS: %d",
		if state.isRecording then "ACTIVE" else "PAUSED",
		buffer:GetCount(),
		MAX_FRAMES,
		#state.trackedParts
	)
end))

	visualizer:Step(dt)
end))

scripts.code:
-- SETTINGS

local PACK_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itzsum1tblox/Rivals-minecraft-texture-itzsum1tblox-/main/Minecraft_Classic_Pack_v1.2%28day%29.json"
local PATTERN_ID = "136887158756561" -- the game's map pattern
local TILE_STUDS = 4                 -- size of one block in studs (lower = smaller blocks)
local AUTO_PATTERN = false           -- finds the game's other map patterns (fixes half map)
local AUTO_MIN_COUNT = 25
local FALLBACK_PARTS = false         -- covers surfaces that are still bare
local HIDE_OTHER_TEXTURES = false
local MIN_SIZE = 4
local MIN_FACE = 2
local MAX_PARTS = 20000
local TINT = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 175) -- brightness of blocks (lower = darker, fixes washed-out walls)

-- LOADING SCREEN / LOGO
local LOGO_MODE = "custom"           -- "custom" = your logo.png, "original" = game's logo, "remove" = hide it
local LOGO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itzsum1tblox/Rivals-minecraft-texture-itzsum1tblox-/main/logo.png"
local TEXT_SWAP = true               -- changes any text saying "66mods" into NAME_TEXT
local NAME_TEXT = "itzsum1tblox"

-- Folders directly under Workspace that should NOT get blocks (the lobby)
local EXCLUDE_NAMES = {"Lobby", "LobbyMap", "Hub", "Spawn"}

local function log(m) print("[MC] " .. tostring(m)) end

local EXCLUDE = {}
for _, n in ipairs(EXCLUDE_NAMES) do EXCLUDE[n:lower()] = true end

local function topOf(inst)
local top = inst
while top.Parent and top.Parent ~= workspace do top = top.Parent end
return top
end

local function excluded(inst)
if not inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
return EXCLUDE[topOf(inst).Name:lower()] == true
end

-- face sizes + square tiles that line up with a part's edges (used for bare surfaces)
local function faceSize(part, face)
local s = part.Size
if face == Enum.NormalId.Top then
if part:IsA("WedgePart") then
return s.X, math.sqrt(s.Y * s.Y + s.Z * s.Z)
end
return s.X, s.Z
elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
return s.X, s.Z
elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Front or face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
return s.X, s.Y
end
return s.Z, s.Y
end

local function plainEnough(part)
if part.ClassName == "WedgePart" then return true end
return part.ClassName == "Part" and part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block
end

local function fitScale(part, face)
local a, b = faceSize(part, face)
local s = math.max(1, math.min(TILE_STUDS, a, b))
local nu = math.max(1, math.floor(a / s + 0.5))
local nv = math.max(1, math.floor(b / s + 0.5))
return a / nu, b / nv
end


---

-- BLOCK TILE (built in, no download needed)

local B64 = ""

local function decode(s)
local chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local map = {}
for i = 1, 64 do map[chars:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end
local out, acc, bits = {}, 0, 0
for c in s:gmatch("[A-Za-z0-9+/]") do
acc = acc * 64 + map[c]
bits = bits + 6
if bits >= 8 then
bits = bits - 8
local d = 2 ^ bits
local byte = math.floor(acc / d)
acc = acc - byte * d
out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
end
end
return table.concat(out)
end

local TILE
do
local ok, err = pcall(function()
writefile("mc_tile_v2.png", decode(B64))
TILE = getcustomasset("mc_tile_v2.png")
end)
if not ok or not TILE then
warn("[MC] Tile failed: " .. tostring(err))
return
end
end


---

-- PACK (sounds, icons, skies) + MAP PATTERN -> BLOCKS

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local stats, swaps, done = {}, 0, {}
local fallbackParts = 0
local resolved = {}

local function dedupe(parent, face)
if not parent then return end
for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
if c.Name == "_McBlock" and c:IsA("Decal") and c.Face == face then
c:Destroy()
end
end
end

local function applyTile(inst, p)
stats[inst.ClassName] = (stats[inst.ClassName] or 0) + 1
if inst:IsA("Texture") then
inst.Texture = TILE
inst.StudsPerTileU = TILE_STUDS
inst.StudsPerTileV = TILE_STUDS
inst.Transparency = 0
inst.Color3 = TINT
dedupe(inst.Parent, inst.Face)
elseif inst:IsA("Decal") then
if done[inst] then return end
done[inst] = true
local t = Instance.new("Texture")
t.Name = "_McTile"
t.Face = inst.Face
t.Texture = TILE
t.StudsPerTileU = TILE_STUDS
t.StudsPerTileV = TILE_STUDS
t.Color3 = TINT
t.Parent = inst.Parent
inst.Transparency = 1
dedupe(inst.Parent, inst.Face)
else
inst[p] = TILE
end
end

local function report()
local list = {}
for k, v in pairs(stats) do list[#list + 1] = k .. "=" .. v end
log("swaps=" .. swaps .. " | map pattern replaced: " .. (#list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "none yet") .. " | extra parts: " .. fallbackParts)
end

local PROPS = {
Sound = {"SoundId"},
ImageLabel = {"Image"},
ImageButton = {"Image", "HoverImage", "PressedImage"},
Decal = {"Texture"},
Texture = {"Texture"},
ParticleEmitter = {"Texture"},
Beam = {"Texture"},
Trail = {"Texture"},
MeshPart = {"TextureID"},
SpecialMesh = {"TextureId"},
Sky = {"SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp"},
}

local function trySwap(inst, p)
local ok3, v = pcall(function() return inst[p] end)
if not ok3 or type(v) ~= "string" or v:find("^rbxasset://") then return end
local id = v:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or v:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
local new = id and resolved[id]
if new == nil then return end
if new == TILE and excluded(inst) then return end
swaps = swaps + 1
if new == TILE then
pcall(applyTile, inst, p)
else
pcall(function() inst[p] = new end)
end
end

-- changes "66mods" text (any capitalization) into NAME_TEXT
local function fixText(inst)
if not (inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
local function fix()
local ok4, t = pcall(function() return inst.Text end)
if ok4 and type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" then
local new, n = string.gsub(t, "66%s*[Mm][Oo][Dd][Ss]", NAME_TEXT)
if n > 0 then pcall(function() inst.Text = new end) end
end
end
fix()
inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(fix)
end

local function handle(inst)
if TEXT_SWAP then fixText(inst) end
local props = PROPS[inst.ClassName]
if not props then return end
for _, p in ipairs(props) do
trySwap(inst, p)
inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p):Connect(function() trySwap(inst, p) end)
end
end

local ok, err = pcall(function()
local rules = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(PACK_URL)).replacement_rules
local cache = {}

local function getAsset(url)
if cache[url] then return cache[url] end
local name = "mcpack_" .. url:match("([^/]+)$")
if not isfile(name) then writefile(name, game:HttpGet(url)) end
cache[url] = getcustomasset(name)
return cache[url]
end

local good, bad = 0, 0
for _, r in ipairs(rules) do
if r.enabled then
local value
if r.mode == "id" then
value = ""
elseif r.cdn_url and not r.cdn_url:match("%.obj$") then
local ok2, res = pcall(getAsset, r.cdn_url)
if ok2 and res then
value = res
good = good + 1
else
bad = bad + 1
warn("[MC] Failed: " .. tostring(r.name))
end
end
if value ~= nil then
for _, id in ipairs(r.replace_ids) do
resolved[string.format("%.0f", id)] = value -- full digits, no e+14
end
end
end
end
resolved[PATTERN_ID] = TILE -- map pattern becomes blocks
log("files ok=" .. good .. " failed=" .. bad)

-- LOADING SCREEN / LOGO (the 66mods logo images from the pack)
local LOGO_IDS = {"17803962335", "13854780213", "13854780042"}
if LOGO_MODE == "original" then
for _, id in ipairs(LOGO_IDS) do resolved[id] = nil end
elseif LOGO_MODE == "remove" then
for _, id in ipairs(LOGO_IDS) do resolved[id] = "" end
elseif LOGO_MODE == "custom" then
local okL, asset = pcall(getAsset, LOGO_URL)
if okL and asset then
resolved["17803962335"] = asset
resolved["13854780213"] = asset
resolved["13854780042"] = ""
log("custom logo loaded")
else
warn("[MC] logo download failed - upload logo.png to your repo")
end
end

for _, inst in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
task.spawn(handle, inst)
end
game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
task.defer(handle, inst)
end)

end)
if not ok then warn("[MC] Pack error: " .. tostring(err)) end


---

-- AUTO PATTERN: finds the game's other map patterns and swaps them too

if AUTO_PATTERN then
task.spawn(function()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function detect()
local counts, n = {}, 0
for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
n = n + 1
if n % 300 == 0 then task.wait() end
if d.ClassName == "Texture" then
local v = d.Texture
if v ~= "" and not v:find("^rbxasset://") then
local id = v:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or v:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
local part = d.Parent
if id and resolved[id] == nil and part and part:IsA("BasePart")
and part.Size.Magnitude > 6 and not excluded(d)
and not (cam and d:IsDescendantOf(cam)) then
counts[id] = (counts[id] or 0) + 1
end
end
end
end
for id, c in pairs(counts) do
if c >= AUTO_MIN_COUNT then
resolved[id] = TILE
log("auto pattern id " .. id .. " (x" .. c .. ")")
end
end
n = 0
for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
n = n + 1
if n % 300 == 0 then task.wait() end
if d.ClassName == "Texture" then trySwap(d, "Texture") end
end
end

for _, t in ipairs({3, 7, 15, 25}) do    
    task.wait(t)    
    pcall(detect)    
end

end)

end


---

-- FALLBACK: blocks on flat parts that are still bare

if FALLBACK_PARTS then
task.spawn(function()
task.wait(3)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function skin(part)
if fallbackParts >= MAX_PARTS or seen[part] then return end
if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not plainEnough(part) then return end
if part.Transparency >= 0.95 then return end
local s = part.Size
if math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z) < MIN_SIZE then return end
if cam and part:IsDescendantOf(cam) then return end
if excluded(part) then return end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if p.Character and part:IsDescendantOf(p.Character) then return end
end
seen[part] = true

local covered, foreign = {}, {}    
    for _, c in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do    
        if c:IsA("Decal") and c.Texture == TILE and c.Transparency < 1 then    
            covered[c.Face] = true    
        elseif HIDE_OTHER_TEXTURES and c.ClassName == "Texture"    
            and c.Name ~= "_McBlock" and c.Texture ~= "" and c.Transparency < 1 then    
            foreign[#foreign + 1] = c    
        end    
    end    

    local added = false    
    for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do    
        if not covered[face] then    
            local a, b = faceSize(part, face)    
            local skip = math.min(a, b) < MIN_FACE    
                or (face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom and part.Position.Y < 5)    
            if not skip then    
                for _, f in ipairs(foreign) do    
                    if f.Face == face then f.Transparency = 1 end    
                end    
                local u, v = fitScale(part, face)    
                local t = Instance.new("Texture")    
                t.Name = "_McBlock"    
                t.Texture = TILE    
                t.Face = face    
                t.StudsPerTileU = u    
                t.StudsPerTileV = v    
                t.Color3 = TINT    
                t.Parent = part    
                added = true    
            end    
        end    
    end    
    if added then fallbackParts = fallbackParts + 1 end    
end    

local function scan()    
    local n = 0    
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do    
        skin(obj)    
        n = n + 1    
        if n % 100 == 0 then task.wait() end    
    end    
end    

scan()    
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)    
    task.delay(3, skin, o)    
end)    
for _, t in ipairs({8, 20, 40}) do    
    task.wait(t)    
    scan()    
end

end)

end

task.wait(3)
report()
task.delay(30, report)
log("done")
